release: First 3D Rex integration prototype inside the existing Dino World main gameplay scene. Original app layout, dino picker, activity cards, modal flows and artwork for Stan/Jarvis retained.
notes: Added a procedural 3D Rex with articulated jaw, eyelids, segmented tail, arms and legs.
Integrated 3D canvas into the existing main dinosaur slot only; original UI and activities remain.
Stan and Jarvis continue to use the original artwork.
PNG Rex automatically remains visible if WebGL/module initialization fails.
Three.js is loaded from jsDelivr CDN; internet is required for 3D Rex, while the existing game has an image fallback.
This is an integration test build; physical iPhone and full browser QA still required.
